short_description: SafeFUME™ cyanoacrylate fuming chambers are designed to safely develop latent fingerprints using methylcyanoacrylate (CNA) vapor in a controlled environment. Available in multiple sizes from bench top to floor standing models.
full_description:
SafeFUME™ automatic cyanoacrylate fuming chambers create a safe work environment for latent fingerprint development using methylcyanoacrylate (CNA) vapor in a controlled environment. These professional-grade chambers are designed for forensic applications in crime laboratories, law enforcement agencies, and criminal justice education programs.

Available in multiple configurations including bench top models (CA24S-A), standard floor models (CA30S-A, CA48S-A, CA60S-A), tall floor models (CA30T-A, CA48T-A, CA60T-A), and multi-chamber options (CATRI-A, CAQUAD-A). All floor models include caster wheels for mobility.

The chambers feature innovative filtration technology with GP Plus filters for solvent, organic and alcohol removal. Optional features include UV lamp decontamination and side/rear windows for 360° viewing of the development process.
seo_content:
Professional Cyanoacrylate Fuming for Forensic Applications

SafeFUME chambers provide controlled environments for developing latent fingerprints on evidence using cyanoacrylate (superglue) fuming techniques. These chambers are essential tools for:

  • State and Federal Crime Laboratories
  • Crime Scene Investigation Units
  • Law Enforcement Agencies
  • Medical Examiners' Programs
  • Criminal Justice Education

The innovative filtration technology ensures safe operation while the programmable controls allow for precise management of the fuming process. Available in multiple sizes to accommodate various evidence types and laboratory space constraints.
